messages:
marta: Heads up — the synthetic embedding blackbox in ap-southeast1 is flapping, Alertmanager fired twice in ~8m for streaming + embeddings checks.
ajay: saw same, websocket handshakes failing with connection resets (1006) intermittently.
probe-bot: alert: blackbox_probe_failure{region="ap-southeast1",type="embedding_stream"} fired at 2026-03-18T09:12:02Z.
marta: I fired a quick curl from the bastion: `curl -i -N https://inference-apse1.redwood.internal/stream?model=rw-embed-1` — getting 502 / connection reset, logs show repeated `tcp_error` entries.
leo: Can you paste the blackbox exporter/probe config? My gut says SNAT port exhaustion on the NAT gateway (we've hit that during scale bursts before).
marta: current probe config snippet: 
```
module: http_2xx
prober: tcp
timeout: 10s
interval: 60s
targets: ["/stream","/v1/embeddings"]
concurrency: 50
```
sam_c: Our probe runners in ap-southeast1 are all on the same nodepool (k8s-probe-apse1) and use one NAT IP.
ingrid: Quick check on a probe-runner: `netstat -an | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l` -> ~1200 ephemeral sockets.
ajay: That matches SNAT port exhaustion — our current GCP setup gives ~1024 ephemeral SNAT ports per IP in that network config. Streaming probes hold sockets longer so they blow through ports.
marta: Proposed mitigations: 1) rotate probe runners across multiple NAT IPs / nodepools, 2) add jitter + exponential backoff to probe retries, 3) increase Prometheus alert `for:` to avoid flapping (eg 10m), 4) add a probe SNAT utilization metric and Grafana panel.
leo: For the alert rule, prefer changing the expression to be spike-resistant, e.g.:
```
- alert: BlackboxProbeFailures
  expr: increase(blackbox_probe_failed_total{region="ap-southeast1"}[10m]) > 3
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
sam_c: I'll open a ticket to rotate the probe nodepool across two NAT IPs and add a startup script to randomize ephemeral source ports. Assigning to myself now.
marta: I'll prepare a canary probe config to add jitter/backoff (interval jitter ±20%, and backoff up to 2m) and reduce concurrency for streaming targets. Will push to canary namespace first.
ingrid: Also add a runbook step: if ephemeral port usage > 80%, scale probe nodepool down/up or switch to different NAT IPs. Log an event in Grafana.
ajay: FYI streaming endpoints are disproportionately affected because they keep long-lived websockets. Simple 200-checks are less impacted. Consider separating streaming probes onto their own runners.
probe-bot: created issue SRE-8745 (rotate-probe-nat-ips) and attached tracer link https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-8745 assigned to sam_c.
marta: Grafana queries I'll add to the canary dashboard: `blackbox_probe_duration_seconds{job="blackbox"}` and `sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="ephemeral_ports"})` (pseudo). Also correlate with `kube_pod_container_status_restarts` for probe-runner.
leo: Good. Also update alert tuning: use `sum_over_time` so short bursts don't page.
sam_c: Timeline — I'll rotate IPs and deploy the startup script by EOD tomorrow, and update the ticket with steps and rollback.
marta: I'll push probe config canary in ~30m and monitor. Follow-up check in #eng-sre tomorrow 10:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
leo: +1
sam_c: on it, will post progress in the ticket and here.
marta: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the coordination log.
